index.pageTitle: HB E-Learning · Enterprise Internal Training System
index.br: From initial learning to final certification
index.lead: Tailor training modules to specific departments and job roles, enforce sequential mandatory learning paths, evaluate through assessments, and automate the issuance of QR-verifiable certificates.
index.muted: Covers the end-to-end training lifecycle: from content creation and material design to comprehensive reporting.
index.muted2: Rich content creation (text, documents, images, videos). Configure granular settings for duration, passing grades, and individual deadlines.
index.muted3: Assign courses accurately by department and job role. Optimize the personalized learning experience for every employee.
index.muted4: Mandatory course sequences. Learners must fulfill prerequisites to unlock subsequent content.
index.muted5: Diverse question bank (Single choice, Multiple-choice, True/False). Integrated automated grading and anti-cheating mechanisms..
index.muted6: Accurately record learning minutes and video playback positions. Continuously update learning progress on the user Dashboard.
index.muted7: Automatically generate enterprise-grade certificates upon meeting graduation criteria. Enable public authentication via QR code scanning.
index.flowLead: Every step is fully digitized, a complete replacement for manual tracking via Excel or email.
index.step2Desc: Arrange the mandatory order of steps
index.step3Desc: Deliver by department and job role
index.step5Desc: Take quizzes and get instant results
index.step6Desc: Meet the required progress and passing score
index.step7Desc: Release the certificate with a QR verification code
index.roleTitle: A Dedicated Workspace for Each Role
index.roleLead: Data stays protected by access control enforced on both the front-end interface and the back-end API.

aidoc.hintKienThuc: Pico B reads the course description and the content of every lesson in courses that are published or already assigned to learners, then refreshes itself every few hours when a lesson changes. Learners can only look up courses they are assigned to. Quiz content is never indexed, so answers stay hidden. Lessons shorter than 60 characters are skipped, so they may keep showing as partly learned.

aiqr.huongDan: When a question matches one of these, Pico B answers instantly with your wording — no model call, no document lookup. Placeholders: {ten} full name, {ten_ngan} given name, {vai_tro} role. Matching ignores case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "chào" also catches someone typing "chao".
aiqr.hintTuKhoa: One keyword per line — any line matching uses this reply.
aiqr.hintCauTraLoi: You can use {ten}, {ten_ngan}, {vai_tro}. Line breaks are preserved.
aiqr.hintKieuKhop: "Whole question" only fires when the user types exactly that. "Contains" is broader and can hijack real questions.
aiqr.hintThuTu: Lower numbers are checked first. Put narrow matches above broad ones.
aiqr.nhapCauThu: Please enter a question to test.
aiqr.khongKhop: No canned reply matches — the AI will look this up in the documents and answer on its own.

ranking.nhiemVuHint: Mission progress restarts every Monday and is counted from the point log itself, so targets can be changed at any time without anyone losing progress. The bonus goes straight into ranking points as soon as a learner meets the target, once per week, along with a notification. If you lower a target below what someone has already done, they receive the bonus on their next activity that week.
